method: unit universe of one pinned corpus for one v2.31 flow language: every file whose extension is in scope and that the product's own walk reads at the pinned tip (a tracked file the walk refuses is tallied, never asked about), each unit scan extracts lowered into the flow family's four tables (flow::lower - grammar tables and file-local facts only, the core never asked), inventoried with the sha256 of the text, the unit's place and size, and its candidate pool per (kind, stratum) cell read off those tables alone (pools.rs); a unit the lowering could not shape is listed with its reason. Frozen before any verdict is read; the constants are pre-registered here.
